description: Fetches real-time Bitcoin mainnet mempool feerate recommendations in satoshis per virtual byte (sat/vB) across fastest, half-hour, hour, and economy confirmation tiers. Use when checking current Bitcoin L1 network congestion before broadcasting an on-chain BTC transaction; for calculating exact SegWit/Taproot UTXO batch consolidation vByte weights and dust thresholds, use plan_bitcoin_utxo_consolidation instead. Stateless read-only edge call (max 32 KB, 60 RPM): accepts 'confirmation_target', supports '?demo=true' or L402 (50 sats), and returns HTTP 400 if invalid.

confirmation_target.description: Target confirmation speed tier; defaults to 'half_hour' when omitted.

name: estimate_bitcoin_mempool_fees

economyFee.description: Low-priority feerate in sat/vB for non-urgent batch sweeps.

fastestFee.description: Recommended feerate in sat/vB for next-block (~10 min) inclusion.

halfHourFee.description: Recommended feerate in sat/vB for ~30-minute confirmation.

hourFee.description: Recommended feerate in sat/vB for ~60-minute confirmation.

title: Bitcoin Mainnet Mempool Feerate Estimator (sat/vB)
